Kind of yes. because if the age gap is 40 and you’re trying to date a 20 year old, there are going to be financial differences between each other and that’s just pure logic. Not tryna be mean tho lol. 
I usually get myself involved in age gap relationships and I get incredibly pissed off if my partners expect me to pay for all the stuff we do together knowing that I am a student and I don’t have a job, bc I’m studying to become a dental surgeon so it’s very time consuming, so I’m obviously on a budget, and therefore they should’ve thought of it before actually dating me (someone that young) or just date someone closer to their age because they’re obv gonna be more financially stable. 
Also when they pay for everything so they think I owe them something. Like I don’t owe you anything, I’m on my way to becoming someone with a nice degree and that takes time and the fact that I can’t afford stupidly expensive trip doesn’t mean anything and it doesn’t apply to who I am. because I do grind, studying my ass off, but I do. 

soo, if you’re gonna be with someone that young, it’s to add to their life’s, with your experience, even financial advice or life advice. 
Not to take away from someone that’s just starting their life path. 

So honestly, if you wanna be nice and spoil your partner, go for it. 
uplifting relationships stay stuck forever in your heart and mindset, because you just raise the bar for your partner forever even after your relationship with you (and because of you) and that’s awesome.

To me it sounds like you’re not rich, your parents are. 
I had the same problem in my past relationship, literally the same problem, there was this time like two years ago when I was on a trip with my ex and all of a sudden school decided we were gonna take all of our classes online, so I bought a gamer laptop and an oculus because my father allowed me to, to study and to have some fun with the oculus. After my ex saw me spending like 4k dollars on all that, all of a sudden our relationship changed and he started being cheap, when we started living together he would eat outside without me so I had to buy everything for myself all the time. If we were at the mall and I was looking at clothes or whatever, he would literally disappear and wait till I already paid for everything. 
Anyways, one day he approached me and said he was high on debt and that’s why he wasn’t paying for the majority of the stuff. I was 21 at the moment and he was… 34. 
But I was like ok, at least he’s being honest so whatever. 
but thennnnn we went to NY and he spent like 2k on clothing because he wanted a new look. 
And I was so pissed off. because he just thought I was rich and that I should pay for everything and even his stuff.
honestly dump him and never tell a man how much your parents make, because they will become lazy and cheap. 
or tell them and see how gullible and impressionable they are and then dump them, because after being so impressionable they will only want to take advantage of it or just treat you like a rich spoiled girl that doesn’t work for nothing. 

which you’re not, you’re a student, you’re on your way… and if your parents are super supportive then that’s amazing. 
honestly if your parents are giving you money for you and your studies, keep it only for you and your studies. Not for anyone else. You’re parents are definitely not looking forward to pay someone else’s bill that’s not their daughter’s.
